name: The Assayer
place: wanders the old sulphur workings north of the Pit Gate with a rack of flasks, testing every vein with fire
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A Slagborn firecaller who tests sulphur for the warband. His acid flasks leave puddles that eat armour, and his assay flame is a straight beam. At half health he 'tests' the group: three flasks thrown at once over the area, and a crucible of molten sulphur swung round him (get in close).

party.solo: Fair solo at 14; the armour-eating puddles hurt.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: Hm. Let's see what you are made of.
The Assayer holds a flask up to the light and squints at you.
say.death: The Assayer drops his rack. Flasks smash and hiss. 'Low... grade...'
say.reset: The Assayer goes back to scratching notes on a slate.

assay_flame.name: Assay Flame
assay_flame.say: {boss} aims a jet of flame at {target}!

volley.name: Sample Volley
volley.say: Three flasks in the air at once!

crucible.name: Swinging Crucible
crucible.say: He swings the crucible round — get in close!

phases.name: False Weights
phases.say: Not good enough. Into the crucible with you.
